_doc: Read by dev/check_log.py, which checks every WARN, ERROR and FATAL line, STDERR trace heads and INFO lines that report a problem. Each regex is searched in a log line without its timestamp, e.g. '[Server thread/WARN] [logger/]: message'. 'open' entries are checked first: a known problem whose fix lives outside the pack data (still counted as remaining). 'noise': a line the pack cannot fix, dropped; the reason says why. Fixed in the pack data and therefore NOT listed: n1/logfix (wrought iron MetalItem on reloads, Wooden Cog welding/milling/mixing/cutting, createdeco placard, Bells and Whistles metro window, TFC Regrowing Forests regrowth, trainutilities advancements, Sable copycat_catwalk, Twilight Forest dev_new_world, Lithium overwrite conflicts, compat loot tables via dev/gen_loot_silence.py); n4/warnings (KubeJS 'Skipping recipe ..., not a json object' and 'Failed to parse recipe ... Falling back' via dev/gen_recipe_overrides.py, 'Not all defined tags' via empty tag files in kubejs/data for aether, undergarden, cataclysm, rnr, firmalife, almostunified and twilightforest (Aquaculture 2 names twilightforest:in_twilight_forest, G3), FirmaSupplementaries sack loot 'Unreachable entry', ModernFix timing lines via config/modernfix-mixins.properties, Fzzy Config 'Deserialization Error' via the full config/cave_dweller/server_config.toml, 'firmages-server.toml is not correct' via the shipped config/firmages-server.toml, Modonomicon 'Recipe ... not found' for the eight permanently disabled Occultism rituals via hidden book entries in kubejs/data/occultism/modonomicon, SimpleBackups' forced save racing its zip ('Could not save data', AccessDeniedException) via saveAll = false).

noise.regex: ^\[(main|modloading-sync-worker)/ERROR\] \[net\.neoforged\.fml\.common\.asm\.RuntimeDistCleaner/DISTXFORM\]: Attempted to load class (net/minecraft/client/multiplayer/(ClientLevel|ClientPacketListener)|net/minecraft/client/player/LocalPlayer|net/minecraft/client/gui/screens/inventory/HangingSignEditScreen|net/minecraft/client/gui/screens/Screen|com/mojang/blaze3d/systems/RenderSystem|net/minecraft/client/gui/components/Button) for invalid dist DEDICATED_SERVER
noise.reason: 7 per boot: client mixins in the common mixin configs of astikorcartsredux, afc and struts, a Button reference during IMC and TFC's own two client probes ('^ This is fine', which load ClientLevel or LocalPlayer first depending on the load order); skipped on the server, nothing missing.

noise.regex: ^\[Server thread/INFO\] \[STDERR/\]: \[dev\.latvian\.mods\.rhino\.CachedClassInfo:getDeclaredMethods:\d+\]: \[Rhino\] Failed to get declared methods for \S+
noise.reason: Only with the developer command /fa_dump: Rhino cannot reflect item classes whose methods name client-only types; the dump is complete.

noise.regex: ^\[Server thread/ERROR\] \[net\.neoforged\.fml\.common\.asm\.RuntimeDistCleaner/DISTXFORM\]: Attempted to load class (net/minecraft/client/player/AbstractClientPlayer|net/minecraft/client/model/HumanoidModel|com/mojang/blaze3d/vertex/PoseStack|net/minecraft/client/multiplayer/ClientLevel) for invalid dist DEDICATED_SERVER$
noise.reason: Only with /fa_dump: the DISTXFORM half of rhino-dump-declared-methods.

noise.regex: ^\[[^\]]+/ERROR\] \[net\.minecraft\.Util/\]: Detected setBlock in a far chunk \[
noise.reason: A mod's worldgen feature writes outside its 3x3 region (seen once, 2026-10-14 01:59); vanilla drops that block; the feature is not named in the log.

noise.regex: ^\[[^\]]+/WARN\] \[mixin/\]: (@Mixin target \S+ was not found|Error loading class: \S+ \(java\.lang\.(ClassNotFoundException|RuntimeException: Attempted to load class \S+ for invalid dist DEDICATED_SERVER))
noise.reason: Mods' mixin configs name targets of absent mods (Dynamic Trees, Functional Storage, Quark, Farmer's Delight, old Lithium) or client classes; mixin skips them.

noise.regex: ^\[[^\]]+/WARN\] \[mixin/\]: Reference map '[^']+' for \S+ could not be read
noise.reason: Mods ship refmap names in their mixin configs; NeoForge 1.21 runs with Mojang names and needs none.

noise.regex: ^\[[^\]]+/WARN\] \[mixin/\]: Discarding @Unique public method \S+ in \S+ from mod (copycats|evolvedmekanism) because it already exists
noise.reason: Copycats and Evolved Mekanism add methods their target classes already have; mixin keeps the target's.

noise.regex: ^\[[^\]]+/WARN\] \[mixin/\]: Static binding violation: PRIVATE @Overwrite method \S+ in modernfix
noise.reason: ModernFix's own overwrites; mixin widens them as intended.

noise.regex: ^\[[^\]]+/WARN\] \[ModernFix/\]: Option 'mixin\.feature\.measure_time' overriden \(by user configuration\) to 'false'$
noise.reason: ModernFix warns once for every option a user overrides, also through a JVM property (javap ModernFixMixinPlugin.lambda$new$0: isOverridden -> warn); the pack's one override (config/modernfix-mixins.properties) stops its two timing WARNs per start, and no override is silent.

noise.regex: ^\[[^\]]+/WARN\] \[KubeJS/\]: Plugin \S+ (does not load on server side|does not have required mod)
noise.reason: KubeJS reports its optional plugins (client plugin, ftbfiltersystem, worldjs) that do not apply here.

noise.regex: ^\[[^\]]+/WARN\] \[net\.minecraft\.world\.level\.levelgen\.heightproviders\.UniformHeight/\]: Empty height range
noise.reason: Apotheosis adds its deep dungeons (y below 0) to every biome; in a dimension whose floor is at 0 or above the range is empty and the feature skips.

noise.regex: ^\[main/WARN\] \[net\.neoforged\.jarjar\.selection\.JarSelector/\]: Attempted to select a dependency jar
noise.reason: dragonlib, betteradvancedtooltips and architectury are CurseForge dependencies and jar-in-jar of other mods; NeoForge uses the standalone jar.

noise.regex: ^\[[^\]]+/WARN\] \[net\.minecraft\.server\.packs\.VanillaPackResourcesBuilder/\]: Assets URL '[^']+' uses unexpected schema
noise.reason: NeoForge dedicated-server classpath quirk.

noise.regex: ^\[[^\]]+/WARN\] \[draconicevolution/\]:
noise.reason: Draconic Evolution's 'Reactor detonation initiated / Explosion Imminent' lines at class init, unconditional.

noise.regex: ^\[[^\]]+/WARN\] \[(com\.kipti\.bnb\.CreateBitsnBobs|com\.cake\.azimuth\.Azimuth)/\]:
noise.reason: Notices of Create Bits 'n' Bobs (cogwheel assets, default suppression on) and Azimuth (tracks fork) at construction.

noise.regex: ^\[[^\]]+/WARN\] \[net\.neoforged\.fml\.config\.ConfigTracker/CONFIG\]: Configuration file \S+EvolvedMekanism\S+general\.toml is not correct\. Correcting
noise.reason: Evolved Mekanism 1.2.1 defines apt.energyStorage and energyPerInput as Long; TOML reads both as Integer, so the file is rewritten at every start (javap EMGeneralConfig).

noise.regex: ^\[Server thread/WARN\] \[FTB Library/\]: Overriding existing game stages provider
noise.reason: ProgressiveStages takes the stage provider over from KubeJS Stages on purpose (and hands it back at shutdown).

noise.regex: ^\[Server thread/WARN\] \[Modonomicon/\]: Recipe \S+ \(of type \S+\) not found\.$
noise.reason: Below the Arcane and later Ages, Occultism and Theurgy book pages show recipes the Age gate still holds back (books are built at the first join); none at age_9.

noise.regex: ^\[main/WARN\] \[net\.dries007\.tfc\.util\.MetalItem/\]: Item (tfc:metal/ingot/wrought_iron|twilightforest:wrought_iron_bar) was inferred to match multiple metals (wrought_iron and iron|iron and wrought_iron), using former$
noise.reason: 2 lines per start: a dedicated server loads its datapacks before TFC's server config, so inferredMetals (defaultconfigs/tfc-server.toml) applies from the next data load on.

noise.regex: ^\[modloading-worker-\d+/WARN\] \[Every Compat/\]:\s*$
noise.reason: Every Compat's ATTENTION banner whenever config/everycomp-hazardous.toml limits its wood types (n3/deco P2, kept on purpose).

noise.regex: ^\[modloading-worker-\d+/WARN\] \[Supplementaries/\]: Dye color white produced diffuse color -1 \(white\), this should never happen$
noise.reason: Supplementaries 3.9.9 checks its own dye colour table at start and trips on white; no effect on any block or item.

noise.regex: ^\[(main|Server thread)/INFO\] \[Moonlight/\]: Failed to load custom color set definition \{"id":"quark:(rune|shard)",
noise.reason: Moonlight ships color sets for Quark (absent) and reads every pack's copy of the file, so an override cannot replace them. Logged again on every datapack reload (/reload, /firmages ages sync), then on the Server thread.

noise.regex: ^\[[^\]]+/WARN\] \[AllTheLeaks/\]: (If you did \*NOT CRASH\*, consider activating "debugThreadsStuck"|Seems like server is stuck while trying to close\.)
noise.reason: Moonlight 3.7.2 runs Every Compat's dynamic datapack generation (DynamicResourcesProvider.runGenerationPipeline, CompletableFuture.supplyAsync) on a fixed pool of non-daemon threads ('pool-N-thread-1..15') that is never shut down; at 'stop' AllTheLeaks' watcher sees those idle threads when the shutdown passes its window and logs these two lines. The JVM still exits with code 0 (N5 copy, round 3: exit 0 ten seconds after 'All dimensions are saved'; stack trace from debugThreadsStuck in round 4). Not every stop shows it (round 2 did not). A fix belongs in Moonlight (a daemon thread factory or shutting the pool down).

noise.regex: ^\[[^\]]+/ERROR\] \[DustyDecorations/\]: Tried to load a client config on a dedicated server!
noise.reason: Dusty Decorations 1.21.1 registers its client config from common code and logs this ERROR itself on every dedicated-server start (0.10.0 copy boot); the server keeps running and the config is client-only anyway. A fix belongs in the mod.

noise.regex: ^\[spark-java-sampler-[0-9-]+/WARN\] \[spark/\]: Exception occurred while getting world info
noise.reason: spark 1.10.124's background sampler asks the server thread for world info (NeoForgeServerSparkPlugin.executeSync) in the same millisecond the server stops; MinecraftServer.executeIfPossible rejects it with 'Server already shutting down' (0.10.0 copy boot 5, at 'stop'). Harmless, a race inside spark.

noise.regex: ^\[[^\]]+/WARN\] \[net\.neoforged\.neoforge\.common\.ModConfigSpec/CORE\]: (Configuration LoadedConfig\[config=|Incorrect key \S+ was corrected from null to its default, )
noise.reason: defaultconfigs/tfc-server.toml and defaultconfigs/Mekanism/world.toml hold only the keys the pack sets; on the first start of a new server folder NeoForge fills the rest with the mod defaults and logs one WARN per key (about 570 lines, server pack boot 2026-10-16). Kept partial on purpose: a full copy would freeze every default of the mod version and drop the notes in the file. A copy of the test server never shows it, because its config folder already holds the completed files.

noise.regex: ^\[[^\]]+/WARN\] \[net\.neoforged\.neoforge\.common\.ModConfigSpec/CORE\]: Incorrect key (general\.apt\.(energyStorage|energyPerInput) was corrected from (10000000|100000) to its default, (10000000|100000)|kinetics\.fluids\.mechanicalGrindstoneFluidCapacity was corrected from 1000 to its default, 5000)\.
noise.reason: Evolved Mekanism writes apt.energyStorage and apt.energyPerInput with their own default and then 'corrects' the same value (a long against an int range); Create: Enchantment Industry writes a grindstone fluid capacity of 1000 into a file whose range starts at 5000. Both happen when the mod creates its own config file on the first start; no pack file is involved.

noise.regex: ^\[spark-java-sampler-[0-9-]+/WARN\] \[spark/\]: Timed out waiting for world statistics$
noise.reason: spark's background sampler asks the server thread for world statistics while it is still creating the pack's 40-odd dimensions before 'Done' (0.10.0 copy boot 9, between the Ad Astra orbit levels); the server thread answers after spark's timeout. Harmless, spark only skips that sample.
